detail.select: Select a commit to see its changes.
detail.noFiles: This commit doesn't change any files.

sync.incoming: Not pulled yet. Pull to bring it into this branch.

search.label: Search commits
search.noResultsBody: Try a different search or filter.

filter.label: Filter
filter.pathHint: Only commits that change this path. For example: src/
filter.firstParent: Follow only the first parent of merges

done.undone: Undid the last commit. Its changes and message are still here.
done.checkedOut: Checked out “{{summary}}”. HEAD is now detached.

reset.title: Reset to This Commit
reset.body: Moves {{target}} to “{{summary}}” ({{hash}}). Commits after it leave {{target}}.

modes.softHint: The changes from the commits that leave stay included in the next commit.
modes.mixed: Keep changes in the working folder
modes.mixedHint: The changes from the commits that leave stay, excluded from the next commit.
modes.hardHint: Discards the changes from the commits that leave and any uncommitted changes. Untracked files stay.

reset.uncommitted_one: {{count}} file with uncommitted changes will also lose its current state.
reset.uncommitted_other: {{count}} files with uncommitted changes will also lose their current state.

checkout.title: Check Out This Commit
checkout.body: Checking out “{{summary}}” ({{hash}}) leaves you on a detached HEAD, on no branch. To keep commits you make there, create a branch.

tag.title: Create Tag
tag.name: Tag name
tag.messageHint: With a message, the tag is annotated: it records who made it and when.

wip.meta: Commit them from the Changes tab
wip.body: These changes aren't in any commit yet.

stash.label: Stashed changes
stash.auto: Changes left on {{branch}} when switching branches
stash.detail: Changes stashed as {{name}}. Untracked files aren't shown here.

signature.good_untrustedHint: Signed by {{signer}}, but this key isn't marked as trusted.
signature.badHint: The commit doesn't match its signature; it may have changed after signing.
signature.expiredHint: The signature or the key that made it has expired.
signature.revokedHint: The key that made this signature was revoked.
signature.cannot_checkHint: This computer doesn't have the public key to check the signature.

compare.title: {{base}} ↔ {{target}}
compare.threeDot: What {{target}} changed since it split from {{base}}.

compareBranch.title: Compare with Current Branch
compareBranch.body: Shows what the chosen branch changed since it split from {{current}}.

recover.title: Recover Lost Commits
recover.body: Commits HEAD was on recently (its reflog) that no branch, tag or remote branch holds now. Creating a branch brings one back.

peek.note: No branch holds this commit. Create a branch to keep it.

multi.body: What changed from just before the oldest commit to the newest.

squash.body: Combines the selected commits into one. The oldest commit's author stays, and commits after them are replayed on top.
squash.pushed: Some of these commits are pushed. Afterwards you'll need to force push, which affects others using this branch.
squash.recover: If it goes wrong, Recover Lost Commits… in the Repository menu brings them back.

cherryPickOnto.body: Switches to the chosen branch and applies the commits there. You stay on that branch afterwards, ready to push.
cherryPickOnto.none: There's no other local branch to cherry-pick onto.
